page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.m1 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

Because the instance features dedicated CPU allocation, it provides predictable compute performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable configurations. The lack of bundled local storage and specialized hardware accelerators like GPUs positions this instance as a standard, resource-dense option for workloads that prioritize predictable CPU and memory availability over high-speed local disk I/O.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance appropriate for general-purpose workloads. Suitable use cases include mid-range web servers, application hosting, containerized microservices, and small-scale database deployments that do not require high local IOPS or specialized instruction sets.
